points.K2: 喷嘴下面，金属瞬间汽化
points.K4: 演示：打一块透明硬塑料

shots.scene: 欣欣站在激光切割机旁，举起两只手掌
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a laser cutting machine and holds up both paws.
shots.narration: 出光时，为什么双手要放在外面？
overlay: 危险激光：为什么出光时双手要放在外面

shots.scene: 两只手图标在机器外面，喷嘴下一块透明块
shots.prompt_en: Two hand icons placed outside a machine outline, and a clear block under a nozzle. No people.
shots.narration: 老李用一块亚克力来说明。

shots.scene: 老李站在车间里，身后是储罐和激光切割机
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stands in the workshop with cryogenic tanks and a laser cutting machine behind him.
shots.narration: 老李干激光这一行，已经25年了。

shots.scene: 老李走到切割头前，手里拿着一块厚透明亚克力块
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks to the cutting head holding a thick clear acrylic block.
shots.narration: 今天他要做一个小演示。

shots.scene: 切割头在钢板上安静地移动，只有细细的气流
shots.prompt_en: A cutting head moves quietly over a steel sheet with only a soft stream of gas. No people.
shots.narration: 切割正常的时候，非常安静。

shots.scene: 一个轻柔的声音图标
shots.prompt_en: A soft, gentle sound wave icon. No people.
shots.narration: 只听到轻轻的气流声。

shots.scene: 安静的声音图标旁一个笑脸和盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A soft sound icon next to a smiling face and a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 让人觉得它很温和、很安全。

shots.section_title: 喷嘴下面，金属瞬间汽化
shots.scene: 喷嘴下方小小的间隙放大图，金属变成蒸汽冒出
shots.prompt_en: A magnified view of the small gap under the nozzle: metal turning into vapor and shooting out. No people.
shots.narration: 可喷嘴和金属之间那一小段间隙，
overlay: 喷嘴下面，金属瞬间汽化

shots.section_title: 喷嘴下面，金属瞬间汽化
shots.scene: 间隙里光和火花剧烈翻腾
shots.prompt_en: Inside the tiny gap, intense light and sparks churn violently. No people.
shots.narration: 其实极其剧烈。

shots.section_title: 喷嘴下面，金属瞬间汽化
shots.scene: 金属块图标瞬间消失，变成一缕烟
shots.prompt_en: A metal block icon vanishes instantly into a wisp of vapor. No people.
shots.narration: 金属是被直接汽化掉的。

shots.scene: 两只手放在机器外侧的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: two hands placed on the outside of the machine, away from the nozzle. No people.
shots.narration: 厂家要求，手动出光时双手放在外面。

shots.scene: 老李把空白胶带贴在喷嘴下，准备打点
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer sticks a piece of blank tape under the nozzle to prepare a test shot.
shots.narration: 比如胶带打点，对中镜片的时候。

shots.scene: 老李把手伸到喷嘴下，放好亚克力块，再收回手
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer reaches under the nozzle, places the acrylic block, then pulls his hand back.
shots.narration: 为什么？老李把亚克力块放到喷嘴下。

shots.section_title: 演示：打一块透明硬塑料
shots.scene: 一块厚厚的透明亚克力块放在喷嘴下的纸板上
shots.prompt_en: A thick clear acrylic block sits on cardboard right under the nozzle. No people.
shots.narration: 出光设置，和打点对中完全一样。
overlay: 演示：打一块透明硬塑料

shots.section_title: 演示：打一块透明硬塑料
shots.scene: 手指图标和亚克力块图标比硬度，亚克力更硬
shots.prompt_en: A finger icon and an acrylic block icon compared on a hardness scale; the acrylic is harder. No people.
shots.narration: 亚克力，比手指可硬多了。

shots.section_title: 演示：打一块透明硬塑料
shots.scene: 切割头上方闪一下，出光
shots.prompt_en: The cutting head flashes briefly as the laser fires one shot. No people.
shots.narration: 按同样的功率、同样的时间，打一枪。

shots.scene: 亚克力块里出现一条细细的贯穿孔
shots.prompt_en: A thin channel appears through the acrylic block from top to bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 光从上到下，直接打穿了。

shots.scene: 老李拿起亚克力块，对着镜头展示细孔
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds up the acrylic block to the camera, showing the thin hole.
shots.narration: 光束就这么细。

shots.scene: 亚克力块底面的出口小孔特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the small exit hole on the bottom face of the acrylic block. No people.
shots.narration: 看，它从背面出来了。

shots.section_title: 这就是双手在外的原因
shots.scene: 老李举着亚克力块，另一只手竖起两根手指
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds the acrylic block and raises two fingers with his other hand.
shots.narration: 这就是出光时，
overlay: 这就是双手在外的原因

shots.section_title: 这就是双手在外的原因
shots.scene: 两只手图标在机器外面打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two hand icons outside the machine with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 双手要放在外面的原因。

shots.section_title: 手指垫在喷嘴下，最危险
shots.scene: 旧式接触式切割头的示意图
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of an old contact-style cutting head touching the work surface. No people.
shots.narration: 以前有一种接触式切割头。
overlay: 手指垫在喷嘴下，最危险

shots.section_title: 手指垫在喷嘴下，最危险
shots.scene: 老李用手比划两根手指垫在喷嘴下的动作
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer mimes putting two fingers under the nozzle, with the acrylic block in his other hand.
shots.narration: 有人会用两根手指垫在喷嘴下面。

shots.section_title: 手指垫在喷嘴下，最危险
shots.scene: 手指一滑，光束直接穿过的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: a finger slips under the nozzle and the beam goes right through that spot. No people.
shots.narration: 手指一滑，光就穿过去了。

shots.scene: 手指侧面一道伤口的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a finger with a cut on its side and a bandage. No people.
shots.narration: 很多人手指侧面留下了伤口。

shots.scene: 指甲裂开的图标和一颗钉子图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a split fingernail next to a nail icon. No people.
shots.narration: 还有人指甲被打裂，像被钉子钉穿。

shots.scene: 老李皱眉摇头
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer frowns and shakes his head.
shots.narration: 据说疼得要命。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现安静声音、汽化、亚克力细孔图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside icons of a soft sound, vaporizing metal and an acrylic block with a thin hole.
shots.narration: 安静不等于安全，间隙里金属汽化。

shots.scene: 两只手图标在机器外面，手指图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Two hand icons outside the machine, and a finger-under-nozzle icon crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 打点也能穿透，出光时双手在外。

shots.scene: 欣欣双手举在身前挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds both paws up and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 双手在外，下次见！
